request.name: Used to Reserve, Commit or Abort merchant limit.

description.content: This implementation has been done for the auto top up service where a Merchant's Limit can be reserved (Holds the Limit), Committed (Committed as Success) and Aborted (Limit Rolled Back). If we don't receive a commit or abort within a transaction keep alive period, the request will be aborted which will result in the external party needing to repeat the reserve.
